RG25E
Determination of the viscosity of thermoplastic materials under clean room conditions. The rheometer is also used as a RAM extruder for the production of implants in the pharmaceutical industry.
Customized enquiryProduct brochure
Kapillarrheometer RG25E
Use in clean rooms
The RHEOGRAPH 25E was specially developed for use in cleanrooms and is based on our proven high-pressure capillary rheometer.
The versatile device can be used to determine viscosity and as a RAM or stem extruder for the production of strand-shaped products - for example for implants made of biodegradable plastics as drug carriers.
Why a RAM extruder instead of a screw extruder? 
The RAM extruder uses the platform of a capillary rheometer, an established testing device in the polymer industry. High-precision temperature control creates stable conditions in the reservoir and the material is heated gently and evenly, without the undesirable shear heating that can occur with continuous extruders.
The constant speed die ensures a uniform diameter of the extrudate, which screw extruders often cannot guarantee. The batch process minimizes rejects and material losses and enables the processing of very small quantities, such as temperature-sensitive medicines, from 100 ml per extrusion cycle.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
The RHEOGRAPH 25 E is made of stainless steel and designed in accordance with protection class IP64, making it easy to clean and disinfect. It is suitable for use in class A cleanrooms.
discontinuous RAM extrusion
Advantages
Processing of very small quantities of material
Precise volume output thanks to piston/channel die system
Virtually residue-free material utilization
Minimal shear heating
Easy cleaning by removing the test chamber
Easy documentation and tracing of individual charges
Simple integration of threshold value measurement and cut-off device
Installation in RABS or isolators possible
Specification
 Product features
Complete stainless steel design for operation in clean rooms, class A
Punch speed from 0.00004 to 40 mm/sec over the entire force measurement range of 25 kN
Test channel diameter 20 mm, others on request
Temperature control from +30 °C to +250 °C
Measurement mode “constant speed” or “constant force”
Measurement of piston force, calculation of viscosity
Parameterization, control and measurement with LabRheo software, evaluation via WinRheo II software
SKRIPT control for freely definable automatic measurement and production sequences
CUSTOMIZED TO YOUR REQUIREMENTS
Add-ons for advanced measurements
Our modular add-ons also offer an extended option for characterizing materials.
DIE SWELL MEASUREMENT
The measuring head is mounted below the die. The measurement can be carried out parallel to a viscosity measurement.
Determination of the dynamic and static die swell
Evaluation of a die swell profile (BASELL method)
Swivel arm with continuous height adjustment
Laser measuring head in 0.1 μm or 7 μm version
Optional with automatic melt cutting device
Optional: acquisition of two strings simultaneously
Application: Simulation of material swelling behaviour during extrusion
Best practise
RAM – vs. Screw Extrusion?
Advantages of the discrete, discontinuous RAM extrusion compared to the conventional screw extrusion in the clean room production.

Mini-Bypass-Rheograph
A compact Online-Rheometer for the continuous measurement of MFR and the viscosity function in the polymer production process. The measuring head can be directly integrated with a production extruder.
Product brochure
Online-Rheometer MBR
For demanding extrusion processes
The MINI BYPASS RHEOGRAPH is a real compact masterpiece that can be easily integrated into existing extruder systems thanks to its small size and low weight.
With a width of just 150 mm and a weight of 30 kg, it does not require any complex fastening, making it easier to install and handle. The innovative die closure system also enables quick and easy die changes, making operation particularly user-friendly.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
All GÖTTFERT Online-Rheometers are also available for operation in hazardous areas of danger zones 1 and 2 with classification „Gas-Ex: Ex II 2G Ex h IIC/IIB T2 Gb X“ and „Dust-Ex: Ex II 2D Ex h IIIC/IIIB IP65 Ta,max Db X“
Specification
 Product features
Measuring head can be connected directly to the production line, separate control electronics
Very compact design
Easy die change
Large measuring range due to a shear rate range of 1:1000
Operation at constant speed (shear rate) or constant pressure (shear stress)
Single or multi point measurement
Operation optionally via PC, built-in industrial workstation or otherwise via process control system
Depending on the operating mode, the following measurement results are provided:
Melt index MFR or volume index MVR
FRR (Flow Rate Ratio), ratio of two successive MFR/MVR measurements corresponding to different weight loads during laboratory measurement
Apparent shear rate, shear stress and viscosity
The measurement results are provided in various ways:
Color display on the PC screen
Protocol on the measured value printer
Provision of analog outputs 4 ... 20 mA
Host connection via serial interface
Database access via network (to be implemented by the customer)
CUSTOMIZED TO YOUR REQUIREMENTS
Add-ons for advanced measurements
Our modular add-ons also offer an extended option for characterizing materials.
SHARK SKIN
The Shark Skin measuring head is mounted at the bottom of the test barrel instead of the capillary. With this option it is possible to measure exactly at which critical shear rates surface inhomogeneities occur.
Detection of the Shark Skin effect
Consisting of slit die, three high frequency pressure-sensors (sampling rate up to 20 kHZ), as well as software package
Determination of the frequency spectrum and statistical evaluation of the pressure signal
Optimization in the extrusion, film and coating process
RHEOTENS
The drawability of polymer melts is of utmost importance in many processes of plastics production and processing.
The patented RHEOTENS method has proven to be an extremely sensitive measuring principle that delivers highly reproducible results to show even minimal batch fluctuations.
In addition to the already existing constant speed and constant acceleration, exponential acceleration is now also possible. The determination of the extensional viscosity function according to Prof. Wagner is an integral part of the RHEOTHENS.
The RHEOTENS is well suited as a processability test for materials used in extrusion or film applications.
HAUL-OFF
Our newly developed HAUL-OFF with a maximum speed of 2000 m/min is particularly suited for the characterization of fibre-grade materials. The system can be operated with constant acceleration or at constant speed steps. The pull-down force is measured via a smooth-running, anti-stick coated measuring wheel on a highly sensitive force transducer.
DIE SWELL MEASUREMENT
The measuring head is mounted below the die. The measurement can be carried out parallel to a viscosity measurement.
Determination of the dynamic and static die swell
Evaluation of a die swell profile (BASELL method)
Swivel arm with continuous height adjustment
Laser measuring head in 0.1 μm or 7 μm version
Optional with automatic melt cutting device
Optional: acquisition of two strings simultaneously
Application: Simulation of material swelling behaviour during extrusion
COUNTER PRESSURE CHAMBER
The viscosity of polymers can also depend on the general pressure level. The Counter Pressure Chamber is mounted behind the die and generates a back-pressure at the die outlet, which is measured with an additional pressure sensor.
Determining the pressure dependence of viscosity (pressure coefficient)
Determination of the critical wall shear stress for wall slip
Maximum pressure (Pm) 1200 bar
Temperature range up to 400°C
Optimization of the flow processes in processing machines (injection molding and extrusion tools with long flow paths, melt pumps)
Filter Measuring Head
Investigation of material purity and homogeneity
Quantitative determination of the concentration of contaminants and quality-reducing components
Detection of viscosity inhomogeneities
Operation at constant rotational speed (shear rate)
Compact add-on for the MBR

Side-Stream-Rheometer
Precise melt analysis with a single bore. Easy to install, without complex modifications - for cost-saving and reliable measurements.
Product brochure
Online-Rheometer SSR
Efficient measurement with minimal effort
The innovative annular gap adapter we developed allows the melt supply and return to be realized with just one bore - a unique solution that minimizes the installation effort and saves costs at the same time.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
All GÖTTFERT Online-Rheometers are also available for operation in hazardous areas of danger zones 1 and 2 with classification „Gas-Ex: Ex II 2G Ex h IIC/IIB T2 Gb X“ and „Dust-Ex: Ex II 2D Ex h IIIC/IIIB IP65 Ta,max Db X“
Specification
Product features
Compatibility
The SSR annular gap adapter is compatible with the standardized M18 x 1.5 bore. This allows the SSR to be flexible and quickly connected to any existing bore of the extruder that already provided space for pressure or temperature measurements.
Easy to install
No complex extruder modification or intermediate plates required - the connection is uncomplicated and cost-effective.
Flexibility
The compact design allows horizontal as well as vertical installation with the extruder.
Extended measurement options
The SSR can optionally be operated with two dies and different geometries in order to simultaneously determine the melt flow index and the flow exponent - an important parameter for analyzing molar mass transfer.
Accurate software
The Windows software ROSWin, known, proven and iteratively developed, allows the determination of the melt index in a range of 0.6-60g/10min, or 5-500g/10min, without having to change the die.

Real-Time-Rheometer
Continuous measurement of MFR and viscosity under real-time conditions with melt return.
Product brochure
Online-Rheometer RTR/RTS-TD
Efficient process control in real-time
The Real-Time Rheometer (RTR/RTS-TD) is the perfect solution for continuous monitoring and quality control of high and low viscosity polymers in production. It measures MFR (melt flow index) and viscosity under real production conditions and provides valuable insights into the rheological and molecular structure of your polymer melts in real-time.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
All GÖTTFERT Online-Rheometers are also available for operation in hazardous areas of danger zones 1 and 2 with classification „Gas-Ex: Ex II 2G Ex h IIC/IIB T2 Gb X“ and „Dust-Ex: Ex II 2D Ex h IIIC/IIIB IP65 Ta,max Db X“
Specification
Product features
Melt return
No melt is lost. The disposal and removal of melt is no longer necessary.
Short residence time
Due to the fact that the flow rate of the CS (circulating stream) is up to 100 times higher than the flow rate of the MS ( measuring stream), polymer-related degradation processes are prevented by the correspondingly short dwell times.
Large measuring range
As the circulating stream always ensures a sufficient flow rate, the measuring stream can be run at the lowest pump speeds. The usable control range is 1:1000. This corresponds, for example, to an MFR range of approx. 0.3–100g/10min with one set of dies. Changes in the molecular structure can be measured from a minimum shear rate of 0.1 1/s, wherein the residence time is drastically reduced by the CS.
Short response time
The short residence times resulting from the CS leads to a corresponding short response time when the material is changed.
for even more functionality
Optional units
Twin dies continuously record a defined range of the viscosity function under single-point measurement conditions
3 pressure sensors ensure precise measurements and reliable recording of material properties
Determination of the MVR (melt volume index), the viscosity function and the flow exponent for comprehensive material analysis
The extracted melt is returned directly to a closed circuit after the measurement, which prevents material loss

Rotational Online-Rheometer
Measuring system for continuous, real-time monitoring of viscoelastic properties
Online-Rheometer ROR
Determination of viscoelastic properties of polymer melts
A Rotational Online Rheometer (ROR) is an industrial proven testing instrument integrated to an lab extruder to continuously measure the viscoelastic properties of fluids or polymer melts in real time. Unlike traditional lab rheometers that require manual sample collection, or capillary process rheometers that measure steady shear viscosity, an ROR provides instantaneous feedback on molecular structure (e.g., molecular weight distribution, branching) and flow behavior without manual sample collection and preparation.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
While conventional rotational rheometers in the lab mainly capture polymer structure at low frequencies, and capillary rheometers describe flow behavior at high shear rates, the ROR combines the advantages of both approaches:
fast, process-relevant data on polymer structure and flow behavior in real-time.
Method
Continuous characterization of viscoelastic material properties (G’ and G”)
Material feeding by lab extruder, gear pump, drumunloader or any other feeding unit
Product features
Oscillation frequency 0,1-50Hz
Oscillation deformation ±0,01° (±) – ∞; Rotation
Maximum circular frequency 314 1/s
Maximum shear rate in transient mode 500 s-1
Measurement up to 350°C 
Applications
Materials: Polymer melts or any kind of material which can be extruded or feeded to the Rotational Online Rheometer
Frequency sweep
Amplitude sweep
Temperature sweep
Ramp- Relaxation test with continuous deformation angle
Transient Viscosity with continuous rotation
Measurement at different hydrostatic pressures (pressurized measurement up to 400bar)
